thread:
Ravi (oncall): Noticing a spike of 503s on embeddings write calls to embed-store starting ~03:05 UTC. Some batch uploads failing end-to-end. Opening incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1945678901
Deploy Bot: New deploy of embed-store v2.4.1 rolled at 03:02 UTC. Rollout: 100% to dedicated pools (eu-central + us-east).
Ana (eng-embed): Reproduced locally: writes with >1k vectors are timing out in the write path after the protobuf change. Observed increased write latency and 503s from the dstore write worker.
Victor (infra): Scaling note: embed-store write queue backed up and write-worker pods auto-scaled but started erroring due to RPC serialization errors. Im pausing the rollout and rolling back to v2.4.0 in critical clusters.
Maya (support): Customer impact: 12 reports so far, two customers affected with bulk ingestion pipelines (VectorLabs, DataForge). Informing CS to apply retries and temporary rate-limits.
Ana (eng-embed): Root cause prelim: v2.4.1 introduced a protobuf schema change that is backward incompatible for batched writes (field ordering & a new optional meta field). Older worker processes attempt to read and fail, returning 503. Confirmed repro with golden payload.
Ravi (oncall): Mitigation in progress: rollback initiated at 03:12 UTC for eu-central and us-east dedicated pools. Added a temporary feature flag to reject >500 vector batches until compatibility fix is deployed.
Victor (infra): Rollback finished in us-east at 03:20 UTC; eu-central at 03:22 UTC. Metrics: write 503s dropping to baseline by 03:26 UTC. Monitoring inbound.
Maya (support): Notified VectorLabs and DataForge with recommended mitigation (smaller batch sizes, exponential backoff). Logged support incident INC-2026-990 and linked tickets #3120, #3121.
Ana (eng-embed): Patch PR ready to restore backward compat serialization and add schema migration tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/embed-store/pull/456. Will include a canary run against a dry dataset.
Product Bot: Drafted status update: "We experienced transient 503 errors for embeddings bulk writes after a recent deploy; rollback completed and service recovery observed. A postmortem and compatibility fix are underway."
Ravi (oncall): Next steps: ship fix + tests, require schema contracts for protobuf changes, add pre-deploy canary for binary serialization changes, and schedule postmortem within 24h. I'll put the action items on the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1945678901/postmortem
Maya (support): Marking incident mitigated for now. If any customers still see failures, escalate here. :white_check_mark:
